thread:
priya: pushed a PR to refresh the 'First Boot' tutorial — swaps the curl auth example with an SDK snippet, standardizes env var names, and adds a CI smoke test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523. Can someone from docs + eng take a look? cc @maria @jonathan

maria: quick skim — looks good. two quick things: the env var in the example is `DATABASE_URL` but our starter uses `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. can we standardize on the API key name? also the npm link at the bottom 404s (missing the @scope).

jonathan: I can take the auth snippet updates. do we want to show the raw `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header or prefer `sdk.authenticate(...)` style?

alex: runtime opinion — showing raw header in docs makes it too easy to copy/paste insecure patterns. recommend primary SDK example + one-line curl fallback. sample SDK snippet i prepared: 

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';

const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1-small', prompt: 'Hello world' });
console.log(resp.text);
```

And a tiny curl fallback: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","prompt":"hi"}'`

maria: thanks — also the CI smoke test will need a secrets template for GH Actions. i can add a `.github/workflows/smoke.yml` snippet and a `set-secret` section in the docs.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs sprint target date is 2026-04-01 — try to get merges in by EOD 2026-03-28 to allow review buffer.

priya: updated the PR to use `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, added the SDK snippet + curl fallback, and fixed the npm link (was missing the `@`). updated files: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523/files

jonathan: LGTM on the snippets. tiny nit: for the main tutorial flow i'd lean to `chat` method for the example so users see messages+assistant exchange — i can push that change (1 line).

maria: i'll follow up with the GH Actions secret template in a small PR after this merges. :shipit:

priya: thanks everyone — merging after CI passes. will follow up to backport the snippets to the starter repo and add a short note in the release notes.
